title: Payment Channel and the Prompt-Pay Rate — Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility
content:
**Terms printed for patients of Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility.** Payment-channel points are added to the prompt-pay rate according to how the qualifying payment was made, as recorded on that patient-payment entry:

| Method of the qualifying payment | Points added |
|---|---|
| ACH bank transfer | 1 |
| check | 1 |
| HSA or FSA card | 0.5 |
| card (and any method not listed above) | 0 |

These are percentage points added to the prompt-pay rate, which is applied once to the charge; they are not a second discount.

**Illustrations (hypothetical).** A qualifying payment made by check adds 1 point; the same payment made on a health savings account card adds 0.5; made by credit or debit card it adds none.
